_marker: CHILD-WIDER-THAN-PARENT BASELINE — a committed per-library defect count that may only DECREASE. `overflows` counts in-flow children wider than their parent with a non-text cause; `textCaused` counts the exempted class (the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap, docs/22) separately so it can never flatter the first number. Both ratchet TWO-SIDED: an increase is a new defect, a decrease is a fix that must be re-recorded here with its cause named. Re-record deliberately with `node scripts/child-wider.mjs --write` and say what moved.

rows.cause: overflows(5): ProgressBar `fill` renders 100px inside a 48px `track` in all five Variant cells — ONE defect class, a PERCENT width (`width: 100%`) baked as a px literal by the computed floor. textCaused(6): the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22 §"Text wrapping is not implemented") — Figma text nodes auto-size on one line, so a hugging box holds an unwrapped run.

textCaused(8): all eight are the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap in Accordion (docs/22). Carbon's NON-text overflows were closed by the live-defect round (9c30204, D3) and its own compile receipt keeps a HARD zero on them — this row is the exempted class only.

textCaused(6): the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (AccordionDetails body 426px inside 288px is the canonical case). marginBox(4): Autocomplete's clear/popup indicators carry margin-right -2, so the margin-box wrapper reserves 26px while the 28px control paints over it — the MEANING of a negative margin, not an overflow. Both classes appeared at their current values only after the MUI regen round gave the indicators a real control box (D6b); before that the indicators were bare glyphs with no box to overflow anything.

marginBox(42): every one of the 42 the Carbon round published as "polaris 42" is a NEGATIVE-MARGIN paint-outside, not an overflow. The margin-box wrapper reserves less layout space than its child paints, which is what a negative margin is for. Polaris has ZERO real child-wider overflows. Correcting the published number is the first thing this instrument did when it ran repo-wide.
